If you switch from a business account with a selected project to a personal account, old business project and license details are now thoroughly cleared, preventing project access errors caused by leftover stale data. ⟦This is like showing a stamped membership card directly from your wallet at the gate without ticket staff calling headquarters every time, and handing over a regular visitor pass while returning the VIP badge so outdated passes will not block the entrance.⟧

items.original:
Improved sign-in and startup speed by reading your signed-in identity from the stored credential instead of making a network request on every launch and after browser consent; a failed identity lookup no longer prevents sign-in from completing, and the displayed plan tier no longer briefly disappears during startup.
Fixed sign-in failing with a project access error after switching from a business account with a selected project to a personal account; stale business project and license details are now fully cleared on personal sign-in.

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式自動化更順暢，及時退出且日誌回報清晰
title.en: Smoother headless automation with prompt exits and clear error reporting

body.zh-TW: 將指令串進自動化排程時，最講求乾淨俐落與明確回報。⟦宛如快遞物流車隊的夜間集運，貨件裝車完畢就立即發車，沿途留下明確標籤與簽收單，不因無人簽名而原地乾等。⟧ 啟用無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視窗的非互動執行模式）搭配 `-p` 旗標時，現在送達最終答案便會迅速退出。背景任務與排程計時器受 `--print-timeout` 限制等待結束，但開發伺服器等常駐守護工作會持續運行而不被強制中止。每輪執行省下多達 200 ms 閒置延遲，並跳過生成無人查看的對話標題。遇到無人互動的實作計畫審查時會自動通過。若 `--print-timeout` 中途逾時，會回傳既有輸出並在 stderr 附帶警告成功退出，手動按 Ctrl+C 中斷則維持非零退出碼。嚴重錯誤在 stderr 加上穩定的 `error:` 標記，提示潛在截斷並解釋先前靜默結束的原因。
body.en: Chaining commands into automated workflows demands clean execution and explicit feedback. ⟦Much like a logistics delivery fleet consolidating cargo overnight, departing immediately once loading is complete and leaving clear labels and receipts along the way without idling on-site because no one is there to sign.⟧ When running in headless mode with the `-p` flag, the CLI now exits promptly once the final answer is delivered. Running background tasks and scheduled timers are waited on subject to `--print-timeout`, while persistent daemon tasks like development servers continue running without being forcefully terminated. Each turn cuts up to 200 ms of idle latency and skips generating conversation titles that nobody would see. Non-interactive implementation plan reviews now pass automatically. If `--print-timeout` expires mid-turn, it returns the partial output and exits successfully with a warning on stderr, while manual Ctrl+C interrupts still exit with a non-zero code. Fatal errors add a stable `error:` marker on stderr, noting potential truncation and explaining why previous runs ended silently.

items.original:
Improved headless (`-p`) runs to exit promptly once the final answer is delivered: the CLI waits for running background tasks and scheduled timers to finish, bound by `--print-timeout`, and leaves daemon background tasks such as dev servers running instead of terminating them.
Improved failure reporting in headless (`-p`) runs: fatal errors now appear on stderr with a stable `error:` marker, a note is printed when the response may be truncated, and runs that previously ended silently with no output now explain why.
Improved headless (`-p`) turnaround by cutting up to 200 ms of idle latency per turn and skipping the model call that generated a conversation title no one would see.
Changed what happens when `--print-timeout` expires mid-turn: the CLI now returns the partial output it has and exits successfully with a warning on stderr, instead of failing with a timeout error; interrupts such as Ctrl+C still exit non-zero.
Fixed headless (`-p`) runs stalling forever on implementation-plan approval that no one could give; non-interactive runs now proceed through plan review automatically.

title.zh-TW: 讀取網址改為預先詢問，工具審查提示說清緣由
title.en: URL fetching asks for permission first and tool approval prompts explain reasons clearly

body.zh-TW: 讓 AI 代勞查資料或動用本機工具時，安全把關更加清晰。抓取網址的預設權限從一律允許改為先問過你，除非預先授權，否則讀取網址前都會請求同意。工具審核提示也迎來翻新，明確點出審核項目——例如詢問 `Run this command?`、`Allow access to this URL?` 還是 `Allow calling this tool?`。編輯命令的快捷鍵僅在審核命令時提供，避免介面混淆。當審核原因不明顯時，下方會附上一行 `Reason:` 說明緣由，例如觸發了掛鉤（hook，在特定事件發生時觸發的攔截小程式）標記，或是涉及其他專案的檔案。⟦這彷彿在大門加裝智慧訪視對講機，外人想進門必須先按鈴通報，螢幕上清楚顯示對方的來意與身分，還會註記警衛攔檢的理由，不再讓人盲目按下開門鈕。⟧
body.en: Security guardrails are much clearer when having AI fetch data or invoke local tools. The default permission for fetching URLs has changed from always allowed to asking first, requesting approval before reading a URL unless pre-authorized. Tool approval prompts have also been revamped to specify exactly what is being approved—such as asking `Run this command?`, `Allow access to this URL?`, or `Allow calling this tool?`. The shortcut for editing commands is only offered when approving a command, preventing interface confusion. When the reason for approval is not obvious, a `Reason:` line is attached below explaining why, such as a hook flagging the action or a file belonging to a different project. ⟦This is like installing a smart intercom at the front door: visitors must ring first, the screen clearly displays their identity and purpose, and notes any guard inspection reasons so you never press the door release blindly.⟧

items.original:
Improved tool approval prompts to say exactly what you are approving — for example `Run this command?`, `Allow access to this URL?`, or `Allow calling this tool?` — with the command-editing shortcut offered only when a command is being approved, and a `Reason:` line explaining why approval is being requested when it is not obvious, such as a hook flagging the action or a file belonging to a different project.
Changed the default permission for fetching URLs from always allowed to asking first, so the agent now requests approval before reading a URL unless you have granted access.

title.zh-TW: 模型名稱轉換留存日誌，稽核軌跡隨時可查
title.en: Model name resolutions are logged for traceable audit trails

body.zh-TW: 在終端機指定模型名稱時，背後的實際流向現在一清二楚。⟦如同在藥局憑處方箋領藥，當藥劑師因原廠藥缺貨或劑型調整而替換成同成分學名藥時，收據與藥袋上都會清楚加註替換紀錄與變更原因。⟧ 命令列工具增強了模型選擇的稽核能力。當你輸入的模型名稱在後台被解析對應到另一款模型時，日誌都會詳實記錄具體轉換過程。無論是輸入別名對應到正式名稱、透過 `--effort` 旗標切換到不同推理程度的變體，或是先前儲存的舊模型因下架廢棄而被替換，日誌中都有跡可循。這讓你不必猜測背後到底跑的是哪一個版本，隨時都能追溯實際運行的模型。
body.en: When specifying model names in the terminal, the actual underlying resolution is now crystal clear. ⟦Much like filling a prescription at a pharmacy where an out-of-stock brand-name drug is substituted with an equivalent generic, with the replacement record and rationale clearly noted on the receipt and label.⟧ The CLI tool has enhanced its auditability for model selection. Whenever a model name you specify resolves behind the scenes to a different model, the logs faithfully record the specific conversion process. Whether resolving an alias to an official name, switching to a different reasoning variant via the `--effort` flag, or replacing a deprecated saved model, everything leaves a clear trail in the logs. This removes any guesswork about which version is running behind the scenes, allowing you to trace the active model at any time.

items.original: Improved model selection auditability: the CLI log now records whenever a model name you specify resolves to a different model, such as alias resolution, `--effort` variant selection, or replacement of a deprecated saved model.

title.zh-TW: 外掛重裝乾淨覆蓋目錄，MCP 相對路徑基準修正
title.en: Plugin reinstalls cleanly replace directories and MCP relative paths resolve accurately

body.zh-TW: 管理擴充套件與隨附工具時，現在不再留下惱人的殘存檔案。過去重新安裝外掛時，來源端已經刪除的舊檔案仍會留在目錄裡；現在安裝會精確替換整個外掛管理目錄，且若嘗試從外掛自身的已安裝目錄再次執行安裝，會被直接拒絕以防目錄損壞。解除安裝外掛後，也不會在 `config.json` 中留下殘餘的啟用或停用項目。同時，外掛所定義的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器若使用相對路徑或未指定工作目錄，先前會依錯誤位置解析；現在一律以該外掛本身的目錄為基準進行解析，確保隨附腳本正常運行。⟦恰似替相機更換擴充鏡頭套組，換上新套件時會徹底移走舊鏡片，拆除時順便清除控制選單裡的舊按鍵，套組內的專用濾鏡也一律以該鏡頭接環為基準精準卡位。⟧
body.en: Managing plugins and bundled tools no longer leaves annoying leftover files behind. Previously, reinstalling a plugin left old files that were already deleted from the source inside the directory; now, installation replaces the managed plugin directory exactly, and attempting to install from the plugin's own installed directory is directly rejected to prevent corruption. Uninstalling a plugin also no longer leaves leftover enabled or disabled entries in `config.json`. Meanwhile, if MCP servers defined by plugins use relative paths or leave the working directory unset, they previously resolved against the wrong location; they now consistently resolve against the plugin's own directory, ensuring bundled scripts run properly. ⟦Just like swapping a camera lens kit: mounting a new set completely removes old glass, detaching it cleans up stale button mappings from the control menu, and dedicated kit filters align accurately against the lens mount.⟧

items.original:
Fixed plugin reinstalls keeping files that had been deleted from the source: installing a plugin now replaces its managed directory exactly, installing a plugin from its own installed directory is refused instead of corrupting it, and uninstalling a plugin no longer leaves its enabled/disabled entry behind in `config.json`.
Fixed MCP servers defined by plugins resolving relative or unset working directories against the wrong location; they now resolve against the plugin's own directory so plugin-bundled scripts run correctly.

title.zh-TW: 子代理啟動不再遺漏工具，任務結束即刻解鎖佇列
title.en: Subagents reliably discover tools at startup and release queued messages upon completion

body.zh-TW: 多工派發子代理處理複雜任務時，工具抓取與狀態切換更加可靠。先前在系統啟動時存在競爭問題，如果外部工具伺服器仍在初始化，子代理往往會撲空。現在 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器會確保初始化完成，讓子代理隨時能找到工具。此外，特別是在超長對話中，子代理在執行完畢後有時會卡在運行狀態；這不僅造成狀態誤判，還會讓原本排隊等候閒置時發送的訊息一路卡住，非得重啟程式才能送出。如今這兩項瑕疵都已修復，子代理在任務結束後會正確切換狀態並如期交付排隊訊息。⟦有如工廠調派實習助理進場作業，開工前一定等儀器暖機完畢才放行領取工具，任務交代完畢也會立即回報交班，不再假裝忙碌而讓後續排隊的派工單全部卡死在收發室。⟧
body.en: Dispatching subagents for complex multi-tasking now offers more reliable tool discovery and state transitions. Previously, a startup race condition meant subagents could fail to find tools if external tool servers were still initializing. Now, MCP servers ensure initialization finishes so subagents can always find their tools. Additionally, especially in very large conversations, subagents sometimes appeared stuck in a running state after finishing; this caused incorrect status reporting and left messages queued for idle delivery stuck until restarting the application. Both issues are now resolved, so subagents properly transition their state and deliver queued messages on schedule once tasks finish. ⟦Like assigning an intern assistant on the factory floor: they are only sent to fetch tools after equipment warms up, and they report shift handovers immediately upon finishing tasks rather than pretending to stay busy and stalling dispatch orders in the mailroom.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a startup race where subagents could fail to find tools from MCP servers that were still initializing.
Fixed subagents sometimes appearing stuck in a running state after they had finished — especially in very large conversations — which also left queued when-idle messages undelivered until restart.

title.zh-TW: 終端機命令及時釋放內部狀態，長工作階段記憶體大降
title.en: Terminal commands release internal state promptly to cut memory usage in long sessions

body.zh-TW: 長時間在同一個工作階段中連續敲入指令，不再面臨記憶體越吃越腫的窘境。以前工具內部存在記憶體流失（程式結束運算後未及時釋放資源的現象）缺陷。只要在終端機中執行過任何命令，該命令的內部狀態就會被保留在記憶體中，直到整個工作階段（session，從啟動到關閉的完整使用過程）結束為止。這導致使用者若是開啟長期會話並執行大量指令，記憶體用量就會一路飆升。這次修復徹底清除了執行完畢後的殘留狀態，讓執行許多指令的長工作階段大幅降低記憶體消耗。⟦就像廚房料理台每做完一道菜就立即隨手擦拭乾淨，不再將用過的空盤與鍋具一路堆到打烊，就算連續出餐一整天，工作檯面也始終保持輕盈俐落。⟧
body.en: Running continuous commands in the same session no longer leads to runaway memory bloat. Previously, the tool suffered from a memory leak where every executed terminal command retained its internal state in memory for the rest of the session. As a result, running many commands in extended sessions caused memory usage to surge continuously. This fix thoroughly clears residual state once commands finish, significantly reducing memory consumption in long sessions that run many commands. ⟦Much like wiping down a kitchen countertop immediately after each dish instead of piling up used plates and pots until closing time, keeping the workspace neat and uncluttered even during a full day of service.⟧

items.original: Fixed a memory leak where every finished terminal command kept internal state alive for the rest of the session; long sessions that run many commands now use significantly less memory.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板在高縮放螢幕不再貼邊，重開位置精準
title.en: Windows panel no longer clings to screen edge at high scaling, reopening accurately

body.zh-TW: 使用 3840x2160 高解析度螢幕並開啟 250% 縮放時，Windows 面板現在會準確開在畫面之內。⟦這好比木工師傅照著設計圖施工，助手卻誤把圖面上的公尺當成公分再放大換算，讓做好的櫃子直接卡死在牆角。⟧底層套件 `pywebview 6.2.1` 回傳的螢幕範圍明明是實體像素，卻標記成縮放 1.0。後續 `move()` 與 `resize()` 又拿視窗自身 DPI 重複相乘，使得預設水平坐標被算成 3840 − 380 − 12 = 3448，將面板釘在右下角邊緣，且該位置還被存檔讓每次重開都重演。現在程式只在主螢幕回報 1.0 且視窗 DPI 不是 96 時，才用視窗自己的 DPI 將螢幕矩形換算回邏輯像素，避免未來 `pywebview` 修好時重複換算；同時將 `window.show()` 排在擺位之後，面板絕不再閃現在舊位置。
body.en: When using a 3840x2160 high-resolution display with 250% scaling, the Windows panel now opens accurately within the screen bounds. ⟦This is like a carpenter building according to blueprints, but an assistant mistakes meters for centimeters and scales them up again, leaving the finished cabinet wedged tightly against the wall corner.⟧ The underlying package `pywebview 6.2.1` returns screen bounds in physical pixels but labels them with a scale of 1.0. Subsequent `move()` and `resize()` operations then multiplied their inputs by the window's own DPI again, causing the default horizontal coordinate to be calculated as 3840 − 380 − 12 = 3448, pinning the panel to the bottom-right edge, and that position was saved so every relaunch repeated the issue. Now the program converts screen rectangles back to logical pixels using the window's own DPI only when the primary screen reports 1.0 while the window DPI is not 96, preventing double conversion if a future `pywebview` release fixes this; at the same time, `window.show()` is queued after placement, ensuring the panel never flashes at a stale position.

items.original: **The Windows panel opens inside the screen at high display scaling** ([#130](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/130)). pywebview 6.2.1 returns screen bounds in physical pixels but labels them as scale 1.0, while `move()` / `resize()` multiply their input by the window's DPI again. At 250% on 3840x2160 the default x came out as 3840 − 380 − 12 = 3448, pinning the panel to the bottom-right edge, and that position was saved, so every relaunch repeated it. Screen rectangles are now converted to logical pixels with the window's own DPI (only when the primary screen reports 1.0 while the window DPI is not 96, so a future pywebview that fixes this is not double-converted), and `window.show()` is queued behind the placement so the panel never appears at a stale position.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板支援混合縮放多螢幕，重開精準回到原螢幕
title.en: Windows panel supports mixed-scaling multi-monitor setups, reopening precisely on the original display

body.zh-TW: 外接不同螢幕工作的讀者，若各螢幕設定了不同的縮放比例，關閉 Windows 面板後重新開啟，它現在會老實回到當初關閉的那台螢幕。先前系統儲存面板位置時，是把實體像素除以視窗當下所在螢幕的 DPI；這導致在 225% 縮放螢幕上關閉的面板，重新開啟時卻莫名其妙彈回 100% 的主螢幕。新版改為直接儲存實體像素，等到擺放面板位置時，才搭配視窗當下的 DPI 進行換算。⟦這如同在不同比例尺的地圖之間穿梭，標記位置時若除以當前圖紙比例，重新翻開時便會走樣跳回起點；改存真實公尺距離後，在哪張地圖合上就在哪張地圖展開。⟧這項改進完全不改變偏好設定的鍵名與資料格式。
body.en: For users working with external monitors configured with different scale factors, closing the Windows panel and reopening it now reliably returns it to the specific display where it was closed. Previously, the system saved the panel's position by dividing physical pixels by the DPI of whichever display the window was currently on; as a result, a panel closed on a 225% scaling display would unexpectedly jump back to the 100% primary screen upon reopening. The new version saves positions directly in physical pixels and only converts them using the window's current DPI when placing the panel. ⟦This is like navigating between maps of different scales: if marked locations are divided by the current sheet's ratio, reopening them distorts the coordinates back to the starting point; storing the actual meter distances instead ensures that whichever map you close on is where you reopen.⟧ This improvement leaves preference key names and data formats completely unchanged.

items.original: **The Windows panel reopens on the display it was closed on with mixed scaling.** The saved position was physical pixels divided by the DPI of whichever monitor the window was on at that moment, so a panel closed on a 225% display reopened on the 100% primary. Positions are now saved in physical pixels and converted with the window's current DPI when placed. The preference key and shape are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板放寬矮螢幕縮放下限，按鈕與狀態列不再裁切
title.en: Windows panel relaxes zoom floor on short displays, preventing buttons and status row from being cut off

body.zh-TW: 把 Windows 面板開在偏矮的螢幕上時，若曾碰過重新整理或結束按鈕被切出畫面外的窘境，現在這類版面裁切問題已徹底解決。⟦這彷彿在低矮的天花板下擺放展示架，若硬性規定層架間隔不能縮小，最底層的控制旋鈕就會被地面擋住；按空間比例動態調降底線，底部按鍵才不被擠出視野。⟧過去面板設有 0.6 的縮放下限，卻未考慮視窗自身的 DPI，使得 2560x1440 搭配 225% 縮放時，面板被卡在比實際需要更大的縮放比例，導致速率與狀態列以及重新整理和結束按鈕全部掉出畫面之外。現在 Windows 將縮放下限改為 `MIN_PANEL_SCALE / window DPI scale`，確保文字顯示依然絕不小於 100% 螢幕的 0.6 倍，同時讓整張面板順利塞進螢幕內；macOS 則維持原樣不變。
body.en: When opening the Windows panel on shorter screens, any issues where the Refresh or Quit buttons were cut off outside the viewport are now completely resolved. ⟦This is like placing a display rack under a low ceiling: if shelf spacing is rigidly forbidden from shrinking, the bottom control knobs get blocked by the floor; dynamically lowering the floor based on available space keeps bottom buttons from being squeezed out of view.⟧ Previously, the panel enforced a 0.6 zoom floor without accounting for the window's own DPI, causing the panel at 2560x1440 with 225% scaling to remain stuck above the zoom level it actually needed, which pushed the rate and status row as well as the Refresh and Quit buttons entirely off-screen. Windows now changes the zoom floor to `MIN_PANEL_SCALE / window DPI scale`, ensuring text rendering is still never smaller than 0.6× of a 100% display while allowing the entire panel to fit smoothly inside the screen; macOS remains unchanged.

items.original: **The bottom of the Windows panel is no longer cut off on short high-DPI screens.** The 0.6 zoom floor did not account for the window's DPI, so at 2560x1440 @225% the panel was held above the zoom it needed and lost its rate/status row and Refresh/Quit buttons. Windows now uses `MIN_PANEL_SCALE / window DPI scale` as the floor, so text still never renders smaller than 0.6× of a 100% display; macOS is unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Windows 系統匣提示限制字數，避免例外吞沒導致面板停更
title.en: Windows tray tooltip enforces character limit, preventing swallowed exceptions from stalling panel updates

body.zh-TW: 開啟 Windows 系統匣觀察各家 AI 用量，開著的面板現在絕不會無聲無息地停止更新。先前新增了 Grok 欄位之後，在英文介面且每家提供商額度皆滿 100% 的極端狀況下，提示文字長度會達到 129 個字元；這讓底層圖示套件 `pystray` 拋出 `ValueError: string too long` 錯誤，但該錯誤卻被背景工作常駐程式 `_refresh_worker()` 默默吞掉，連同該輪更新畫面的 `inject_state()` 也一併跳過，導致面板看似開著卻再也不會刷新數據。現在系統匣提示文字強制限制在 127 個字元以內，徹底防範字串過長引發的崩潰。⟦這種脫節宛如展場跑馬燈因文字過長當機，值班警衛不但沒回報還順手切斷訊號線，讓大廳螢幕默默停在上一輪舊畫面。⟧
body.en: When opening the Windows tray to check AI usage across providers, an open panel will no longer silently stop updating. Previously, after adding the Grok row, tooltip text reached 129 characters in the extreme case of an English interface with every provider's quota at 100%; this caused the underlying icon library `pystray` to raise a `ValueError: string too long` error, which was silently swallowed by the background worker `_refresh_worker()`, skipping that cycle's UI update `inject_state()` as well and leaving the open panel unable to refresh data. The tray tooltip text is now strictly capped at 127 characters, completely preventing crashes caused by excessively long strings. ⟦This disconnection is like an exhibition marquee crashing from text that is too long, and instead of reporting it, the duty guard casually disconnects the signal cable, leaving the lobby display quietly frozen on the previous frame.⟧

items.original: **The Windows tray tooltip is capped at 127 characters.** Since the Grok row was added, the English tooltip with every provider at 100% reached 129 characters; pystray raised `ValueError: string too long`, which `_refresh_worker()` swallowed along with the same iteration's `inject_state()`, so an open panel silently stopped updating.

title.zh-TW: 終端機狀態列與接續提醒自動換新，補齊修復並校準版號
title.en: Terminal status line and session resume hooks update automatically, incorporating fixes and aligning version numbers

body.zh-TW: 先前已在電腦中安裝過狀態列與工作階段接續提醒的使用者，現在升級時會自動替換成最新版腳本。過去這兩支 hook（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）雖然歷經多次修改，涵蓋狀態列進位的 `1000k` 修正以及 7 月以來工作階段接續提醒的十項修正，卻因為未調升版號，讓既有安裝一直留在舊檔案。新版將狀態列升級至 1.6 版、接續提醒升級至 1.7 版，安裝程式會主動用最新副本覆蓋舊檔，並新增自動化測試確保腳本版號與安裝常數隨時步調一致。⟦這恰似圖書館借閱處更新了服務規章，封皮上的版本代號卻漏未換新，讓館員誤以為抽屜裡積滿灰塵的舊手冊仍是現行規定。⟧
body.en: Users who previously installed the status line and session resume hooks on their systems will now have them automatically replaced with the latest script versions upon upgrading. In the past, although both hooks underwent numerous modifications—including the status line rounding fix for `1000k` and ten fixes to session resume since July—the lack of version bumps left existing installations stuck on older files. The new release bumps the status line to version 1.6 and session resume to 1.7, with the installer actively overwriting old files with the latest copies and adding an automated test to ensure script version numbers and installer constants stay strictly in step. ⟦This is just like a library circulation desk updating its service policies but forgetting to update the version code on the cover, leading librarians to mistakenly believe the dusty manual in the drawer is still the active rulebook.⟧

items.original: **Installed status line and session resume hooks are replaced with the current copies.** Both scripts had changed without a version bump — the status line's `1000k` fix and ten session-resume fixes since July — so existing installs kept the old files. The status line goes to `1.6` and session resume to `1.7`, and a new test keeps the session-resume script version and installer constant in step.

title.zh-TW: 自訂 Claude Code 設定路徑處處生效，狀態列與專案用量不再空白
title.en: Custom Claude Code config paths take effect everywhere, keeping status lines and project usage from going blank

body.zh-TW:
如果你搬移了 Claude Code 的設定資料夾，狀態列與專案用量現在處處都能正常讀取。⟦這好比工作室搬遷後，公文仍投進舊信箱，讓新辦公室的值班看板始終查無進度。⟧先前「設定狀態列」仍寫進 `~/.claude/settings.json`，Claude Code 根本不讀，兩條額度長條圖停在 0% 且標記「即將重置」；備援機制甚至翻出過期的 `~/.claude.json`，且從 Finder 或 Dock 開啟的桌面程式抓不到終端機變數，專案用量一片空白。

```
# 路徑解析順序（逗號分隔時讀取全部、寫入第一筆）：
# 1. 環境變數 CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
# 2. launchctl getenv CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
# 3. 預設路徑 ~/.claude

# 跟隨變數搬移：settings.json, .claude.json, projects/
# 固定留在原處：狀態列腳本, usage-status.json, 偏好設定
```

新版 `loaders/claude_paths.py` 依序解析目錄，Claude Code 檔案跟著走，而 usage 自己的檔案固定留在原處，避免子行程與桌面端分頭讀寫造成錯位。
body.en:
If you relocate Claude Code's configuration directory, the status line and project usage can now be read properly everywhere. ⟦It is like moving to a new studio while official mail is still delivered to the old mailbox, leaving the duty board in the new office with no updates to display.⟧ Previously, "Set Up Status Line" still wrote to `~/.claude/settings.json`, which Claude Code never read, leaving both quota bars stuck at 0% with "Reset imminent"; the fallback mechanism even surfaced a stale `~/.claude.json`, and desktop apps launched from Finder or the Dock could not catch terminal environment variables, leaving project usage completely blank.

```
# Path resolution order (reads all when comma-separated, writes to the first entry):
# 1. Environment variable CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
# 2. launchctl getenv CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
# 3. Default path ~/.claude

# Moves with the variable: settings.json, .claude.json, projects/
# Stays pinned in place: statusline script, usage-status.json, preferences
```

The new `loaders/claude_paths.py` resolves directories in order so that Claude Code files follow the variable while usage's own files stay pinned in place, preventing misalignment from subprocesses and the desktop app reading and writing in different locations.

items.original: **`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is respected everywhere, not only for transcripts** ([#129](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/129)). With a relocated Claude Code config dir, "Set Up Status Line" wrote to `~/.claude/settings.json`, which Claude Code never read, so both quota bars sat at 0% with "Reset imminent", the fallback surfaced a stale `~/.claude.json`, and Project Usage stayed empty because an `.app` launched from Finder or the Dock does not inherit the shell environment. A new `loaders/claude_paths.py` resolves the directory from the environment, then `launchctl getenv CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, then `~/.claude`; comma-separated values are read in full and written to the first entry. Files Claude Code owns follow it — `settings.json`, `.claude.json` (inside the directory whenever the variable is set, the same rule Claude Code uses), and `projects/`. usage's own files — the statusline script, `usage-status.json`, prefs — stay pinned to `~/.claude`: the script runs as a Claude Code subprocess and sees the variable while the app may not, and deriving both from it would let them write and read in different places.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列 Token 在單位邊界不再顯示 1000k，並補齊十億級距
title.en: Status line token counts no longer show 1000k at unit boundaries, adding the billion step

body.zh-TW: 在狀態列查看消耗進度時，若 Token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）數值剛好逼近單位邊界，現在不再顯示彆扭的 `1000k`。⟦這種尷尬宛如汽車儀表板的里程計數器，在行駛累積到九百九十九點五公尺時本該跳轉為一公里，卻因提早進位而顯示出一千公尺；重新對準門檻後，大單位才會準時接棒切換。⟧過去三支狀態列腳本在數值達到 1,000,000 時才升級為 `M`，但 `k` 是整數格式化，999,500 以上會先四捨五入成 `1000k`；腳本也沒有 `B` 級距，使得 15 億被印成 `1500.0M`。現在門檻改為比對進位後的邊界（`k` 到 `M` 用 999,500、`M` 到 `B` 用 999,950,000）並補上 `B` 級距，對齊 `ui/tables.py` 既有的正確寫法。
body.en: When checking usage progress in the status line, token values near unit boundaries no longer display an awkward `1000k`. ⟦This awkwardness is like a car odometer that should flip to 1 kilometer at 999.5 meters, but instead displays 1000 meters due to early rounding; readjusting the threshold ensures the larger unit takes over right on time.⟧ Previously, the three status line scripts only upgraded to `M` when reaching 1,000,000, but `k` used integer formatting, causing values of 999,500 and above to round up to `1000k` first; the scripts also lacked a `B` step, causing 1.5 billion to be printed as `1500.0M`. The thresholds now compare against rounded boundaries (999,500 for `k` to `M`, 999,950,000 for `M` to `B`) and add the `B` step, matching the existing correct implementation in `ui/tables.py`.

items.original: **Token counts no longer read `1000k` at a unit boundary.** The three statusline scripts promoted to `M` at `value >= 1_000_000`, but `k` is formatted `:.0f`, so anything from 999,500 rounded to `1000k` first; there was no `B` step either, so 1.5 billion read `1500.0M`. The thresholds now compare against the rounded boundary (999,500 for k→M, 999,950,000 for M→B) and a `B` step was added, matching the already-correct version in `ui/tables.py`.

title.zh-TW: 報表週趨勢長條支援懸停顯示，標註日期區間與花費
title.en: Report weekly trend bars support hover display, showing date ranges and costs

body.zh-TW: 打開用量報表查看每週趨勢長條時，滑鼠移過去現在會即時浮現日期區間與花費。⟦這有如專案白板上的進度橫條，湊近細看才能得知起訖日期與開銷明細，且剛進行三天的當週絕不會虛報成整整七天。⟧以前每列長條只標記 Token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）數量，完全看不出那是哪一週、花了多少費用。新版在滑鼠懸停時補齊了具體時間與金額，顯示的日期區間也會嚴格限制在報表的實際範圍內，讓還沒過完的最後一週不會宣稱涵蓋七天、旁邊卻只有三天的數據。
body.en: When viewing weekly trend bars in the usage report, hovering over them now reveals their date range and cost. ⟦It is like a progress bar on a project whiteboard where looking closely reveals exact start and end dates and expense details, ensuring a current week with only three days is never falsely shown as a full seven days.⟧ Previously, each row only marked token counts, with no way to tell which week it was or how much it cost. The new version provides the exact timeframe and amount on hover, and clamps the displayed date range strictly to the report's actual span so an unfinished last week does not claim seven days next to three days of numbers.

items.original: **Weekly trend bars in the report show their date range and cost on hover.** Each row only carried a token count, with no way to tell which week it was or what it cost. The range is clamped to the report's actual span, so an unfinished last week does not claim seven days next to three days of numbers.

title.zh-TW: 報表洞察備忘改為方角無框，對齊全列填色風格
title.en: Insight notes in reports become square and borderless, matching full-row fill styling

body.zh-TW: 報表底部的洞察備忘（提供用量趨勢與分析提醒的備忘列），現在全面改為方角、無外框的淡色整列。它們原本是整個報表介面中最後一處還帶有外框的表面，帶有 8px 圓角與 3px 左側色條，現在已改為與報表其餘整列填色完全一致的視覺風格。⟦整張介面有如筆記本排版，當所有章節內容都已換成清爽的無框滿版底色時，最後一個帶有外框與側邊色條的便簽也同步抹平框線，讓整頁閱讀動線不再突兀。⟧
body.en: Insight notes at the bottom of the report are now entirely square, borderless tinted full rows. They were originally the last framed surfaces left across the entire report interface, featuring 8px rounded corners and a 3px left stripe, and have now been updated to match the visual style of the report's other full-row fills. ⟦The entire interface is like a notebook layout where, once all chapter contents have switched to clean borderless full-bleed background colors, the last sticky note with a border and side stripe also flattens its outlines so the reading flow across the page is no longer disjointed.⟧

items.original: **Insight notes in the report are square, borderless tinted rows.** They were the last framed surface left — 8px corners and a 3px left stripe — and now match the report's other full-row fills.

title.zh-TW: 移除 AI 人才市場面板，簡化安裝與發版流程
title.en: Remove AI Talent Market panel and simplify installation and release workflows

body.zh-TW: 挑選現成的 AI 角色卡，不再需要獨立面板。⟦這就像在背包外硬加專用工具袋，原廠斷貨讓袋子成了空擺設；既然主袋本就自帶夾層，拆掉它不但減重也省去扣具保養。⟧專案正式移除了 AI 人才市場面板。該面板原本用來瀏覽精選的 subagent（子代理）角色卡並安裝至 `~/.claude/agents/` 目錄。隨著 Claude Code 內建角色選擇，加上 GPT Store 示範了平台自帶功能後的目錄命運，三篇論文也證實角色前綴會削弱推理。該面板還夾帶私有專案編譯出的唯一外部二進位檔 `vendor/instate-cli`，發版密鑰 `INSTATE_CLI_TOKEN` 曾兩度過期，悄悄出貨少了 23 MB 且面板全空的程式。移除該功能一併拆掉了校驗檔、指紋防呆、發版上傳下載流程，以及面板一致性與主題計數腳本中專屬 macOS 的特例。
body.en: Choosing ready-made AI persona cards no longer requires a dedicated panel. ⟦It is like attaching a dedicated tool pouch to the outside of a backpack only for the manufacturer to discontinue it into an empty ornament; since the main bag already comes with built-in compartments, removing it not only sheds weight but also saves buckle maintenance.⟧ The project officially removed the AI Talent Market panel. The panel was originally used to browse curated subagent persona cards and install them into the `~/.claude/agents/` directory. As Claude Code built persona selection directly into the platform, and the GPT Store demonstrated the fate of catalogs once the host platform ships its own features, three papers also confirmed that persona prefixes degrade reasoning. The panel also carried the project's only external binary compiled from a private project, `vendor/instate-cli`; its release secret `INSTATE_CLI_TOKEN` expired twice, silently shipping an app that was 23 MB lighter with an empty panel. Removing this feature also eliminated the checksum file, fingerprint guards, release upload and download workflows, and macOS-specific carve-outs in the panel parity and theme-count scripts.

items.original: **AI Talent Market.** The panel browsed a curated set of subagent personas and installed them into `~/.claude/agents/`. Claude Code has since built persona selection in itself, and the evidence against the pattern accumulated from the other side: the GPT Store showed what happens to a persona catalogue once the host platform ships its own, and three papers now report that a persona prefix measurably degrades a model's reasoning rather than sharpening it. The panel also carried the project's only vendored binary — `vendor/instate-cli`, built from a separate private project, fetched during release through a `INSTATE_CLI_TOKEN` secret that expired twice and silently shipped a 23 MB-lighter app with an empty panel. Removing the feature removes that whole chain: the checksum file, the fingerprint guard, the release upload/download dance, and the macOS-only carve-outs in the panel parity and theme-count scripts.

title.zh-TW: 移除 AI 圓桌討論視窗，回歸專注保護用量額度
title.en: Remove AI Council window and refocus on protecting usage quota

body.zh-TW: 想並排比較不同 AI 的回答，交給兩個終端機視窗處理得更快。專案正式移除了 AI 圓桌討論視窗。這項功能過去會在獨立視窗中，讓 Claude Code、Codex 與 Antigravity 進行多輪討論，開始前提供 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）預估、過程中計票共識，並支援唯讀資料夾存取。它是專案最大的子系統，在 `discussion/` 目錄佔了約 3,600 行程式碼。但它產出的成果，只是由兩款工具並排回答同一題且一次結束，開兩個終端機視窗早就更快。用量監控工具不該拿來跑對話，花掉的額度正是它存在所要保護的額度。若日後需要精簡版本，零件都仍完整留在 git 歷史紀錄中。⟦這種矛盾宛如行動電源上的電量螢幕，為了展示炫目動畫日夜長亮，耗盡的反而是出門在外最需要保留的備用電力。⟧
body.en: Comparing answers from different AI tools side by side is much faster when left to two terminal windows. The project officially removed the AI Council window. This feature previously ran multi-round discussions between Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity in a separate window, providing upfront token estimates, consensus tallying during the process, and read-only folder access. It was the project's largest subsystem, accounting for roughly 3,600 lines of code across the `discussion/` directory. Yet the output it produced was merely two tools answering the same question side by side in a single pass, which opening two terminal windows already achieved faster. A usage monitor should not be used to run conversations; the quota it consumed was the exact quota it exists to protect. If a stripped-down version is ever needed in the future, the parts remain fully intact in git history. ⟦This contradiction is like a battery indicator screen on a power bank that stays lit day and night to show flashy animations, draining the very backup power you need to preserve most when away from home.⟧

items.original: **AI Council.** A separate window ran a multi-round discussion between Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity, with a token estimate up front, consensus tallying, and read-only folder access. It was the largest subsystem in the project at roughly 3,600 lines across `discussion/`, and the thing it produced — the same question answered by two tools, side by side, ending in one pass — is something two terminal windows already do faster. title.zh-TW: GitHub API 流量支援自訂閘道，身分驗證與網址維持直連
title.en: GitHub API Traffic Supports Custom Gateways, While Authentication and URLs Remain Direct

body.zh-TW:
企業若需要稽核或集中管控網路流量，現在可以透過個別主機的 `api_host` 設定，將 GitHub API 請求導向自訂閘道（gateway，把流量轉去另一個位址再送出的中繼點）。這項改動只會轉發 API 呼叫，登入身分驗證、Git 遠端儲存庫操作與瀏覽器開啟網址仍會直接連線至原始主機。此功能目前仍處於實驗階段，且不是安全邊界，部分請求可能依然會送往原始主機。

```
# 設定將 github.com 的 API 流量轉發至自訂閘道
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# 查詢特定主機目前設定的 API 閘道位址
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦這就像公司設立的公務收發室，員工採購與查詢資料等業務公文統一由專屬窗口轉交處理，但員工出勤打卡、私人包裹寄送與親自拜訪仍直接走大樓正門。⟧
body.en:
Organizations that need to audit or centrally manage network traffic can now route GitHub API requests to a custom gateway via the per-host `api_host` setting. This change only forwards API calls; login authentication, Git remote repository operations, and browser-opened URLs still connect directly to the original host. This feature is currently experimental and is not a security boundary, so some requests may still reach the original host.

```
# Set up forwarding API traffic for github.com to a custom gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Query the currently configured API gateway address for a specific host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦This is like a company mailroom for official business, where business documents such as procurement requests and data inquiries are routed through a dedicated counter, while employee clock-ins, personal parcel deliveries, and in-person visits still go directly through the building's main entrance.⟧

items.original:

```shell

# Read the configured API host

```

The original host remains in use for authentication, Git remotes, and browser URLs.

title.zh-TW: 在命令列直接把截圖和影片附進 issue 與 PR
title.en: Attach screenshots and videos to issues and PRs from the command line

body.zh-TW:
⟦你把沖洗好的照片一張張貼進日誌本，寫到哪一頁就貼在哪一頁；頁面上原本寫著「照片放這裡」的位置，照片會直接蓋上去，其他頁則往後補貼。⟧回報問題時想附一張截圖，以前得先開網頁上傳。現在 `gh` 多了 `--attach`，直接把本機的圖片和影片傳上去，接進 issue、pull request 或留言的內文。

```shell
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

內文若已經寫到那個本機路徑，`gh` 會把它換成上傳後的網址；沒寫到就補在最後。同一次指令要附多個檔案，就重複寫幾次這個旗標。這功能在 GitHub.com 與 GitHub Enterprise Cloud 上都能用。
body.en:
⟦You paste developed photos into a logbook page by page: where a page already says "photo goes here", the print covers that spot; elsewhere it goes on at the end.⟧ Reporting a bug with a screenshot used to mean opening the web page to upload it first. `gh` now has `--attach`, which uploads local images and videos and puts them into the body of an issue, a pull request, or a comment.

```shell
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

If the body already references that local path, `gh` swaps in the uploaded URL; otherwise the attachment is appended. Repeat the flag to attach several files in one invocation. Attachments work on GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Cloud.

items.original:
## Attach images and videos to issues and pull requests

The repeatable `--attach` flag uploads local images and videos and adds them to issue, pull request, or comment bodies. If a body already references the local path, `gh` replaces it with the uploaded URL; otherwise it appends the attachment:

```shell
# Attach files when creating or editing an issue
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh issue edit 123 --attach ./walkthrough.mp4

# Attach files when creating or editing a pull request
gh pr create --attach ./before.png
gh pr edit 456 --attach ./after.png

# Attach files to comments
gh issue comment 123 --attach ./repro.png
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

Repeat the flag to attach multiple files in a single invocation. Attachments are available on GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Cloud.

For more information see https://gh.io/gh-attach and https://github.blog/changelog/2026-09-01-github-cli-media-in-issues-pull-requests-and-comments/

title.zh-TW: `gh issue develop` 能另開工作目錄，手上的東西不用收
title.en: `gh issue develop` can check the branch out in a separate worktree

body.zh-TW:
手邊的改動改到一半，issue 那頭又要你開一條新分支——以前得先收拾現場才能切過去。現在 `gh issue develop` 可以幫 issue 建好連動的分支，並且把它簽出到一個新的 Git worktree（工作樹，讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能），你目前這份工作目錄原封不動。

```shell
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

⟦工地要趕另一項工程時，不必把現場拆掉重排，而是在旁邊另闢一塊作業區，兩邊同時進行。⟧
body.en:
You are halfway through a change when an issue needs a fresh branch, and until now you had to tidy up before switching over. `gh issue develop` can now create the linked branch for an issue and check it out in a new Git worktree, a second working copy of the same project that stands on its own, leaving your current working copy untouched.

```shell
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

⟦When a site has to start a second job, the crew does not tear down what is already laid out; they open a separate work area beside it and run both at once.⟧

items.original:
## Worktree support extended to `gh issue develop` 

`gh issue develop` can now create a linked branch and check it out in a new Git worktree, leaving your current working copy unchanged:

```shell
# Create a linked branch for an issue and check it out in a worktree
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

Passing the `--worktree` flag creates an independent worktree, Git's feature for parallel working copies. You can inspect and test the changes in a separate folder while your current branch and files stay undisturbed.

body.zh-TW: 在專案裡搜尋 issue（議題，追蹤問題與建議的討論清單）時，以前只能比對一模一樣的關鍵字。⟦像找歌時忘記歌名，哼出大概的旋律能按感覺找；若還記得一小段歌詞，便把歌詞片段和旋律一起交給找歌的人。⟧`gh search issues` 現在新增了 `--search-type` 旗標，支援語意搜尋與混合搜尋兩種模式。當你記不清確切的錯誤文字時，輸入概念描述並加上 `--search-type semantic`，便能依背後涵義找出相近的討論；加上 `--search-type hybrid` 則會同時比對關鍵字與語意。

If you cannot remember the exact error text, pass `--search-type semantic` with a natural concept description to find relevant issues by meaning; using `--search-type hybrid` combines traditional keyword matching with semantic understanding.

title.zh-TW: 新增排程清理技術債技能，定期維護專案程式碼
title.en: Added scheduled tech debt burndown skill for periodic maintenance

body.zh-TW: 專案維護久了，程式庫常累積零星的待辦標記、過時設定或待整理的舊結構，平時卻抽不出完整時間手動整理。專案現在為 AI 代理新增了排程清理技術債技能（tech debt burndown skill，定期處理專案累積技術債務的專用指令技能）。在排程設定中啟用並排定觸發時間後，代理便會按固定週期自動檢視並清理這些技術債。⟦像在大樓日誌裡排定例行大掃除，定期把倉庫堆積的雜物與舊箱子清運出去，不讓零碎雜物越積越多。⟧透過將清債任務標準化與排程化，專案能持續維持程式碼的整潔度與健康度。
body.en: As a repository grows, it often accumulates lingering TODOs, outdated configurations, or disorganized code structures that developers rarely have dedicated time to clean up. The project now introduces a scheduled tech debt burndown skill for AI agents. Once configured with a schedule, the agent automatically triggers on a recurring interval to inspect the codebase and clean up technical debt. ⟦It is like putting a regular deep-cleaning schedule on the building calendar to clear out accumulated clutter from the storage room before it piles up.⟧ Standardizing and scheduling these cleanups helps teams keep the repository tidy and maintainable over time.

items.original: Add a scheduled tech debt burndown skill by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14095

title.zh-TW: 程式碼審查技能更名為 `code-review`，簡化呼叫識別
title.en: Renamed cli-code-reviewer skill to code-review

body.zh-TW: 專案調整了程式碼審查技能的命名，將原本的 `cli-code-reviewer` 正式更名為更簡短的 `code-review`。這項變更讓技能名稱更直覺且符合日常用法，去除多餘的前綴詞後也更容易被指令系統與開發者辨識。⟦像把辦公室門口冗長的「內部文件審查員室」標示，更換成簡潔明瞭的「審查室」門牌。⟧這次更名僅調整技能識別名稱，不影響原有的審查功能與運作機制。
body.en: The repository renamed the `cli-code-reviewer` skill to the simpler and more concise `code-review`. Dropping the verbose prefix makes the skill name more intuitive and easier to recognize when invoking agent capabilities. ⟦It is like replacing a wordy "Internal Document Reviewer Room" sign on an office door with a clean, straightforward "Review Room" plaque.⟧ This update changes only the identifier, leaving the underlying review functionality unchanged.

items.original: Rename cli-code-reviewer skill to code-review by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14116

title.zh-TW: Linux APT 套件庫改採雙金鑰簽署
title.en: Linux APT repository now uses dual-key signing

body.zh-TW: Linux 系統的 APT 套件庫現在同時以兩把金鑰進行簽署。在 CI（持續整合，自動執行檢查的流程）中，團隊先前曾短暫加入驗證 Linux 套件庫簽署金鑰的臨時步驟，在確認簽署狀態正常後隨即撤回該臨時步驟。整項改動僅涉及雙金鑰簽署與臨時驗證步驟的清理。⟦像在同一份公文上同時蓋上兩枚印章以供雙重辨識，期間查驗處短暫增設了核印櫃檯，確認無誤後隨即撤除。⟧
body.en: The Linux APT repository is now signed with both keys simultaneously. In CI (continuous integration, an automated checking process), the team briefly added a temporary step to verify the repository signing keys, then promptly reverted that check after confirming the setup. The update focuses strictly on the dual-key signing and cleaning up the temporary verification step. ⟦It is like stamping an official document with two separate seals for dual verification, while an inspection checkpoint is briefly set up to verify the stamps before being removed.⟧

title.zh-TW: 測試不再讀取本機認證與 Git 設定
title.en: Tests no longer read local authentication or Git configuration

body.zh-TW: 你在自己的電腦上跑測試時，登入認證與 Git 設定本來就可能和其他人的不同，讓測試帶著個人環境的影子。這次調整把測試和本機的認證、Git 設定隔開，使測試執行時不再讀取這兩類本機資料。⟦像把實驗樣本放到專用的乾淨工作台上，只讓實驗指定的材料進場，不把研究員口袋裡的東西混進結果。⟧重點不是換掉你的認證或 Git 設定，而是讓測試不依賴它們。
body.en: When you run tests on your own machine, its authentication and Git configuration can differ from someone else's and leak personal-environment details into the run. This change isolates tests from both kinds of local data, so they no longer read local authentication or Git configuration. ⟦It is like placing samples on a dedicated clean workbench, allowing in only the materials for the experiment rather than anything in the researcher's pockets.⟧ Your credentials and Git settings are not being replaced; the tests simply no longer depend on them.

items.original: Isolate tests from local machine's auth and git configuration by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14128

title.zh-TW: 部署驗證接受預發布標籤
title.en: Deployment validation accepts pre-release tags

body.zh-TW: 部署流程驗證版本標籤時，現在接受預發布（pre-release，正式發布前使用的版本標籤）標籤。預發布標籤用來標示正式發布之前的版本；部署驗證會把這一類標籤視為可接受的輸入。⟦像活動入口除了正式票券，也核驗試營運場次的票券，兩種票都能通過入口。⟧這項調整只改部署驗證對標籤的接受條件，讓使用預發布標籤的部署流程不必在驗證處被擋下。
body.en: When a deployment flow validates a version tag, it now accepts a pre-release tag, a tag for a version before formal release. Deployment validation therefore treats that tag type as acceptable input. ⟦It is like an event entrance validating tickets for a trial-run session as well as tickets for the formal opening, letting both through the gate.⟧ The change is limited to which tags deployment validation accepts, so a deployment using a pre-release tag is not stopped at that check.

items.original: Accept pre-release tags in deployment validation by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14193

title.zh-TW: 以 `reflect.Pointer` 取代已淘汰的 `reflect.Ptr`
title.en: Replaced deprecated `reflect.Ptr` with `reflect.Pointer`

body.zh-TW: 程式碼把已淘汰的 `reflect.Ptr` 改為 `reflect.Pointer`，完成一次 API（應用程式介面，程式用來呼叫功能的固定方式）替換。這不是新增另一種呼叫方式，而是將原先使用的過時名稱換成目前的名稱。⟦像把老舊規格的轉接頭換成現行規格，插在原本位置仍是為了完成同一段連接。⟧若你正在閱讀相關程式碼，看到 `reflect.Pointer` 就是在辨認這項替換後使用的 API。
body.en: Code now replaces deprecated `reflect.Ptr` with `reflect.Pointer`, completing an API (application programming interface, a fixed way for programs to call a capability) substitution. This does not add a second way to make the call; it changes the outdated name that the code used to the current one. ⟦It is like swapping an old-standard adapter for one that meets the current standard while using the same connection point.⟧ When reading the relevant code, `reflect.Pointer` is the API used after this replacement.

items.original: Use reflect.Pointer instead of deprecated reflect.Ptr by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14098

title.zh-TW: 不需要清理時不再要求功能偵測註解
title.en: Feature detection no longer requests cleanup comments when unneeded

body.zh-TW: 功能偵測（feature detection，先確認功能是否可用的做法）不需要清理時，現在不再要求清理註解。這條規則把是否需要清理當成是否提出註解要求的界線：有清理需要的地方可留下相應註解，沒有清理需要的地方則不因同一件事再被要求補註。⟦像工作單只在確有後續收尾工作時附上提醒；沒有待收尾的項目，就不多附一張提醒單。⟧改動的重點是刪除不必要的要求，讓註解要求和實際清理需要對齊。
body.en: When feature detection (checking whether a capability is available) needs no cleanup, it no longer requests a cleanup comment. Whether cleanup is needed now forms the boundary for asking for that comment: a corresponding comment can be left where cleanup is needed, but an item needing none is not asked for one. ⟦It is like attaching a reminder to a work order only when follow-up work really remains; an item with nothing to finish gets no extra reminder slip.⟧ The change removes an unneeded request so that the request for a comment matches the actual need for cleanup.

items.original: Don't ask for feature detection cleanup comments when not needed by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14139

title.zh-TW: 建置工具與相依套件升級，Dependabot 新增 aw-actions 群組

body.en: Dependabot configuration now includes an `aw-actions` group, while `aw-actions`, `codeql-actions`, sigstore-go, gRPC, go-containerregistry, actions/attest, azure/login, goldmark, protobuf, testify, x/crypto, lipgloss, and a compression library were updated. Go moved through 1.26.6 to 1.26.7, CI's golangci-lint reached v2.12.2, gh-aw workflows reached v0.85.4, and gh-aw-actions reached v0.87.1 with agentic workflows recompiled. ⟦It is like replacing parts from a maintenance list while updating the automatic replenishment rule and already assembled work orders too.⟧
